detail.demoBannerText: This is a sample project to show you what QualiPulse can do. Ready to run your own study?
detail.unsavedChanges: You have unsaved changes in the Setup tab. Discard them?
detail.nextStep2: Monitor replies in the Responses tab
detail.nextStep3: Run AI Analysis once you have 3+ completed interviews
detail.welcomeModalSubtitle: Share this link and start collecting responses — your first insights could be in as soon as an hour.
detail.proTip: The first 3 participants are the most valuable. Aim to recruit from inside your existing network — teammates, recent customers, or community members — rather than cold outreach.
detail.noAutoLink: We couldn't auto-generate an interview link. Head to the Overview tab to create one manually.
detail.editingFieldAria: Editing {{field}}. Press Enter to save or Escape to cancel.

tour.clickHint: Click the highlighted element to continue
tour.overviewHero_body: You're inside the demo study. Every study opens on its Overview — the research objective sits at the top, so anyone landing here knows what the study is trying to learn.
tour.overviewStats_body: Participants, completed interviews and completion rate update as interviews come in. The demo already has completed interviews for you to explore.
tour.overviewLink_body: Participants join through a share link — send it out and the AI voice interviewer handles every conversation in the browser, no scheduling, no calls to run.
tour.goSetup_title: Next: how the interview is designed
tour.goSetup_body: The Setup tab holds the questions the AI interviewer asks. Open it to take a look.
tour.setupGuide_body: Main questions, what you hope to learn from each, and screening questions to filter participants. The AI improvises follow-ups around this guide — it's what you'll customise for your own study.
tour.goResponses_body: The Responses tab holds the completed interviews. Open it to see them.
tour.responsesList_body: Each participant's conversation is recorded and transcribed automatically. Click any participant to read their transcript turn by turn — you can fix wording and tag the quotes that matter.
tour.goAnalysis_body: The Analysis tab shows what the AI made of all the interviews. Open it for the finale.
tour.analysisReport_body: The AI synthesises themes, tensions and recommendations across interviews — every claim cites verbatim quotes you can trace back to a transcript. Scroll through to see the full report.
tour.finale_title: That's one study, end to end
tour.finale_body: Guide → interviews → transcripts → analysis. But the real payoff comes across studies — let me show you the cross-study decision memo.
